name: ASPICE
description: Automotive SPICE (ASPICE) requirements specification — SWE.1 / SYS.2 aligned

sections.title: 1. Stakeholder Requirements (SYS.2)
sections.prompt_hint: Identify all stakeholders and document their needs as formal stakeholder requirements (StRS-xxx). Include operational scenarios.

sections.title: 2. System Requirements (SYS.3)
sections.prompt_hint: Derive system-level requirements (SysRS-xxx) from stakeholder needs. Tag each with ASIL level if applicable.

sections.title: 3. Software Requirements (SWE.1)
sections.prompt_hint: Specify software requirements (SwRS-xxx) derived from system requirements. Maintain traceability.

sections.title: 4. Requirements Traceability Matrix
sections.prompt_hint: Create a traceability table: StRS → SysRS → SwRS. Show bidirectional links.

sections.title: 5. Verification Criteria (SWE.4)
sections.prompt_hint: For each SwRS, define verification criteria (method: review/test/simulation, environment, pass/fail criteria).

sections.title: 6. Document Change History
sections.prompt_hint: Provide a change history table with version, date, author, description of change.
